name: DTR/BTZ bounded offline observer
limitations: Recovered from the verified S06 ZIP; no unavailable earlier S07 source or test results were assumed.

Browser fixture-document mode executes actual Chromium UI but uses in-memory fetch and a host SHA-256 adapter; HTTP, native browser Web Crypto and CSP integration are blocked by browser navigation policy.
All root pins are local recording metadata, not IC certificates or proof of game-rule correctness.
Rust/Cargo remain unavailable; native gameplay, Wasm, stable-memory recovery and IC certificates remain unverified.
Production ledger/archive authority, checkpoint timing fairness, payout obligations, real metrics and capacity remain open.
Finite local recordings only. No real inputs, custom recordings, wallet or deployment service.
S06 whole-image persistence and native optimization limitations remain unchanged.
